We sincerely apologize for any issues you may experience. While we do not describe a formal “warranty,” we do stand behind our products and orders:

Damaged or defective items: If your product arrives damaged, has a functional defect, or does not perform as expected, we will review the situation and assist you after you submit details (and, where relevant, photos and proof of purchase) via our online contact form.
Delivery issues or incomplete orders: If your parcel is lost, not received as expected, or contains missing/incorrect items, we will investigate and support you once you contact us with your order information.
Returns and exchanges from our official website: For unused, sealed products purchased on parfums-de-marly.com, you may request a return or exchange within 28 days of delivery (with some exclusions such as Discovery Sets and orders from Bulgaria). The order must be returned in full, including complimentary gifts, and return shipping is at your expense.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
